references.text: Nethanel, son of Zuar, is mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Issachar in the census, demonstrating the tribe's leadership in various contexts.
The descendants of Issachar are counted in the second census, showing the tribe's continuity through the wilderness journey.
Issachar was born as Jacob's son through Leah, and his tribe became one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
The context for sending out spies from each tribe, where Igal son of Joseph represented the tribe of Issachar.
